plain: A sailor; a person who works on a ship at sea

webster.text: A seaman or sailor; one whose occupation is to assist in navigating ships.

example.quote: He had represented our present situation to be calm and peaceable, but it was such a calm as mariners often experience at sea, after a storm, when one ship rolls against another, and they sink.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina House of Representatives (debate on calling the convention), Hon. ROBERT BARNWELL, January 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
